stories.title: Acampada en Sol por la vivienda, en directo | El PSOE y Sumar acuerdan la protección frente a los desahucios hasta 2030 y la prórroga de los alquileres hasta 2028

en.title: Sit-in at Sol for housing, live | PSOE and Sumar agree on eviction protection until 2030 and rent extension until 2028
en.summary: The Spanish government coalition partners PSOE and Sumar reached an agreement on housing protection measures. The government requested an extraordinary parliamentary session on Friday to vote on measures including eviction protections extending to 2030 and rent extensions through 2028.

stories.title: PSOE y Sumar aprobarán dos decretos de vivienda en un acuerdo 'in extremis'

en.title: PSOE and Sumar will approve two housing decrees in a last-minute agreement
en.summary: The Spanish coalition government partners PSOE and Sumar reached a last-minute agreement on housing policy. The government approved two decrees during a Cabinet meeting that began over an hour late due to final negotiations between the coalition parties.

stories.title: PSOE y Sumar salvan un acuerdo en Vivienda con dos decretos tras bloquear el Consejo de Ministros durante más de una hora

en.title: PSOE and Sumar secure agreement on Housing with two decrees after blocking Cabinet meeting for over an hour
en.summary: PSOE and Sumar reached a housing agreement through two separate decrees following disputes over rent extension duration and room rental regulations. The Cabinet session was delayed by over an hour while coalition partners negotiated these contentious issues.

stories.title: El Congreso abre un expediente sancionador a la diputada del PP Ana Vázquez por mostrar un espray de gas pimienta

en.title: Congress opens disciplinary proceedings against PP deputy Ana Vázquez for displaying pepper spray
en.summary: The Spanish Congress opened a disciplinary case against PP deputy Ana Vázquez after she displayed pepper spray. The Chamber's ruling body voted to initiate proceedings that could result in temporary suspension of her parliamentary status and salary.

stories.title: La Mesa del Congreso abre expediente a la diputada que mostró un bote de gas pimienta

en.title: Congress Board Opens Proceeding Against Deputy Who Displayed Pepper Spray Container
en.summary: Spain's Congress Board initiated an investigation into PP deputy Ana Vázquez for displaying a pepper spray canister during a parliamentary session. The deputy has ten days to present her defense before the full chamber decides the case in closed session.

stories.title: La Mesa del Congreso abre expediente a la diputada del gas pimienta y le da 10 días para presentar alegaciones

en.title: Congress Board Opens Proceeding Against Pepper Spray Deputy and Gives Her 10 Days to Present Arguments
en.summary: Ana Belén Vázquez faces potential suspension from office and salary following an investigation by Congress. The full chamber will vote on any sanction in a closed session.

stories.title: Los profesores viven mejor en España que la media de la OCDE mientras se enquistan el paro juvenil y los 'ninis'

en.title: Teachers Live Better in Spain Than OECD Average While Youth Unemployment and NEET Population Remain Entrenched
en.summary: An OECD education report shows Spanish teachers earn above the international average, but the country faces persistent challenges including a five percent decline in primary school enrollment between 2015 and 2024 and elevated youth unemployment.

stories.title: El Gobierno interviene la tarifa de gas y la bombona de butano en un Consejo de Ministros marcado por la vivienda

en.title: Government Regulates Gas Tariffs and Butane Cylinders in Council of Ministers Focused on Housing
en.summary: Spain's government is implementing price controls on gas tariffs and butane cylinders as part of broader measures. Vice President Sara Aagesen announced some details of the new economic package being voted on today.

stories.title: PSOE y Sumar alcanzan un acuerdo para aprobar dos decretos de vivienda a expensas de Junts

en.title: PSOE and Sumar reach agreement to approve two housing decrees pending Junts support
en.summary: The Spanish government coalition partners PSOE and Sumar have agreed on housing policy measures, with rent freezes being a key point of negotiation between the allies.

stories.title: La inflación se dispara al 4,9% en septiembre empujada por los carburantes

en.title: Inflation surges to 4.9% in September driven by fuel prices
en.summary: Energy price increases pushed inflation to its highest level since 2023, while fresh food prices also rose significantly at 5.8%.

stories.title: La subida de los carburantes dispara la inflación al 4,9% en septiembre

en.title: Rise in fuel prices drives inflation to 4.9% in September
en.summary: The government approved protective measures for families and sectors affected by energy costs as fuel price increases pushed inflation higher.

stories.title: Última hora de los decretos de vivienda acordados en el Consejo de Ministros

en.title: Latest updates on housing decrees agreed in the Cabinet meeting
en.summary: The government coalition partners reached an agreement to approve the housing decree during the Cabinet Council meeting.

stories.title: El Gobierno buscará aprobar este viernes en el Congreso los dos decretos de vivienda

en.title: The Government will seek to approve the two housing decrees in Congress this Friday
en.summary: The governing coalition parties have announced an agreement to approve two housing decrees, with plans to vote on them Friday during an extraordinary plenary session of Congress.

stories.title: Las imágenes del XVII Encuentro Financiero EXPANSIÓN-KPMG

en.title: Images from the XVII EXPANSIÓN-KPMG Financial Meeting
en.summary: Leaders from major banks and insurance companies gathered with supervisors and regulators at the EXPANSIÓN-KPMG Financial Meeting to discuss economic and financial challenges.

stories.title: AXA, Santander y Santalucía aceleran el giro del seguro hacia la prevención

en.title: AXA, Santander and Santalucía accelerate insurance shift towards prevention
en.summary: Insurance companies are expanding their focus beyond compensation for claims to become ongoing partners in customers' lives, leveraging technology to address demographic challenges and longevity.

stories.title: El Gobierno anuncia un tope al gas y al butano para contener los precios que desafía a Bruselas

en.title: The Government announces a price cap on gas and butane that defies Brussels
en.summary: The Spanish Government has announced price controls on gas and butane, a measure that conflicts with European Union positions.

stories.title: El Ibex respira a la espera de mayores novedades

en.title: The Ibex catches its breath while awaiting greater developments
en.summary: Oil prices and debt interest continue pressuring markets awaiting macroeconomic data, with the Ibex seeking recovery after recent declines in a period of reduced volatility.
